content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm working on setting up communication between a [product_name] and a [product_name] to allow a customer to access the I/O state (both digital and analog) via RS485 Modbus RTU. As a starting point, I attempted to access it using Modbus/TCP and plan to switch to RS485 later. On my computer, I am using Modbus Doctor as a client. The issue is that I can't retrieve the data reliably. While I'm able to establish a connection with Modbus Doctor to the [product_name], most of the time I encounter timeout responses. Whenever I initiate the connection from Modbus Doctor, it does show up on the [product_name]. I've attached screenshots of my configuration. Each timeout seems to result in the client disconnecting on the [product_name].

Hi [user_name], I'm not sure if this example application will assist, but it's worth reviewing all your data transfer and communication parameters to ensure everything is configured correctly. [product_name] - Modbus RTU Communication example with [product_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is working to establish reliable Modbus communication between two [product_name] devices to access I/O states, but faces frequent timeout errors and unstable client connections. Suggestions include reviewing all communication and data transfer settings, indicating configuration or reliability issues that may affect stable device interaction.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks a dependable Modbus communication link between the connected devices, free from timeouts or client disconnections during operation.
